name: Benzoylfentanyl
summary: Benzoylfentanyl, also known as phenylfentanyl, is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl and has been sold as a designer drug. In the United States, benzoylfentanyl was first identified in Drug Enforcement Administration drug seizures in 2018.

uses.text: Benzoylfentanyl, also known as phenylfentanyl, is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl and has been sold as a designer drug.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs are similar to those of fentanyl itself, which include itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening. Fentanyl analogs have killed hundreds of people throughout Europe and the former Soviet republics since the most recent resurgence in use began in Estonia in the early 2000s, and novel derivatives continue to appear.

pharmacology.en: Like fentanyl, it acts on the mu-opioid receptor. Activating that receptor dampens pain signals and also slows the brainstem centres that drive breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 和芬太尼一樣，它作用於 μ 鴉片受體。活化該受體會抑制疼痛訊號，同時也減緩驅動呼吸的腦幹中樞。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和芬太尼一样，它作用于 μ 鸦片受体。活化该受体会抑制疼痛信号，同时也减缓驱动呼吸的脑干中枢。

fact.en: It was first identified in samples submitted to the US Drug Enforcement Administration, one of many fentanyl analogues that have turned up in forensic laboratories rather than in research.
fact.zh: 它最早是在送交美國緝毒局的樣本中被鑑定出來的，屬於眾多出現在法醫實驗室而非研究中的芬太尼類似物之一。
fact.zhHans: 它最早是在送交美国缉毒局的样本中被鉴定出来的，属于众多出现在法医实验室而非研究中的芬太尼类似物之一。
